changes.title: Book your Heat Check from a phone.
changes.text: The current homepage asks people to call to schedule. The sketch puts a Schedule your Heat Check button right under the headline.

changes.title: Tap to call at the top.
changes.text: Your number sits in the header and in a large button, so a homeowner in Katy can reach you in one tap.

changes.title: Your maintenance agreement up front.
changes.text: The Preferred Customer Maintenance Agreement and its repair discounts get their own card instead of a line at the bottom of the page.
